about: Every line the tricky-words game says. Ids start with the game's id (words-). A new line is "pending" until Barney has recorded it: it shows on the recording page, and the game skips it until then.

lines.how: Announcing the game's name.
Excited, inviting.
Big finish: proud and happy.
Inviting.
Keep the voice up: a word follows ("Find the word… one.").
Light and kind, voice up: the word he tapped follows ("That word is… my."). Never a telling-off.
Pleased and warm.
Pleased and warm.
Pleased and warm.
Keep the voice up: the word follows ("Now build the word… cartoon.").
Pleased, voice up: the word follows ("You built the word… cartoon.").
Friendly, pointing something out: said once a round, as a tricky part lands.
Cheerful and calm, never disappointed. After a first wrong tap or drop.
Warm, side by side: the hint after a second wrong try, as the right word or tile glows.
